title: Example pages have unique long excerpts and distinct TTS backends
description:
Live examples currently replay the ignore-example WAV. Causes: short similar fixtures, Next.js client navigation not re-booting the embed, and 8-character FNV hashes.

## Behavior
Each example has at least two public-domain paragraphs of unique spoken text. Basic and themed use Kokoro. A Qwen example requests tts_backend qwen. Ignore still demonstrates ignore/pronounce on a longer article. Navigating between examples boots a new player for that page's hash. Higgs remains off the examples (tone stub).

See features/example_pages.feature.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Product branch `feat/example-unique-speech` is up. Root cause was Next.js `Script` keeping the first page's attrs and never re-booting. Examples now have unique long public-domain copy; Qwen has its own page. Higgs stays off the demos.

right_now_summary: Example pages now use unique long excerpts, reboot players correctly, and route the Qwen demo to Qwen; Higgs stays off.
